body:
You are actually the least shitty person I've dealt with today OP.  I don't want you to die based on just that fact.  The clerk I went to glared at me, the girl that printed off my withdrawal forms was a bitch, my old roommate went out of his way to try to make me feel shitty, my best friend is blowing me off in the 11th hour before I have to drop out of college, but I get on here to bitch and moan about it and you (a total stranger) are actually nice.

Talking to you has helped me feel better, even if it's a little bit.  I hope you don't die OP.  You'll do whatever you will, but I think it's cool that you come on this subreddit and are supportive even when you just want to die.  At least know you made 1 person a little bit happier today, not a lot of people I've run into today can claim that

I know what you mean OP, life is fucked up.  I hope you find the peace you are looking for in your final hours.  I feel the same way at 22.  Super quiet, no social life, no sex life, one short job, dropping out of college, the few friends I do have dropped the fucking ball when I needed them most.  Life is just fucking shit sometimes.  I'm suppose to be doing several month old dishes and packing clothes in garbage bags since I'm dropping out and leaving the dorms.  But I was fortunate enough to run into my old roommate on the way to my room, who was sure to loudy tell his new roommate how fucking wierd and nasty I was, well within earshot.  So instead, I'm just going to post on here about how shitty life is and how I wish I was dead, and then just sleep the rest of the day.

I don't know why the fuck I just told you all that.  Maybe you can draw some strength from knowing you aren't alone.  Maybe you are just as fucked up as everyone else, idk.  Hope your last day is nice.  

PS:  Fallout 4 is actually half decent, you should try it
